First National Technical Center is a facility in Omaha, Nebraska operated by First National of Nebraska. The operator's published materials describe managed IT services for mainframe, IBM Power, hybrid cloud, distributed systems, and HPC environments, but do not publish specific power capacity, square footage, or technical specifications for this Douglas County location. Without published capacity figures, this campus cannot be assessed for its contribution to AI infrastructure scaling.

Nebraska has 21 mapped data center facilities, but zero have published megawatt figures available to this site. First National Technical Center has no published power specification, placing it outside any ranking of capacity in the state. The absence of published specifications means there is no basis to estimate the number of racks, accelerators, or the grid load this facility represents.

This campus does not currently register as a measurable point in the national AI infrastructure picture, because the operator has not published the technical data required to assess it.
